senses.sense_definition: Iets fijner, nauwkeuriger, eleganter of gevoeliger maken.

examples.text: De kunstenaar probeert zijn techniek te <w>verfijnen</w> door elke dag urenlang te oefenen.

target_lang_translations.en: The artist tries to <w>refine</w> his technique by practicing for hours every day.

examples.text: We moeten onze methode <w>verfijnen</w> om betere resultaten te behalen.

target_lang_translations.en: We need to <w>fine-tune</w> our method to achieve better results.

target_lang_definitions.en: To make something finer, more precise, elegant, or sensitive.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: to improve a method, skill, or system by making small changes
to improve something by making it more elegant or sophisticated
to make very small adjustments to something in order to achieve the best performance
